displayIdentity.body: Seeing the Spirit given through the apostles’ hands, Simon offers money for the same authority; Peter rebukes his attempted purchase and heart, Simon asks for prayer, and the apostles return while preaching in Samaritan villages.
displayIdentity.title: Simon offers money for apostolic authority and is rebuked
